SealedRequirementLineage.title: SealedRequirementLineage
SealedRequirementLineage.description: The sealed requirement-lineage record: immutable requirement-to-package link plus its SHA-256 content digest (exact-revision addressing).

LineageId.title: LineageId
LineageId.description: Opaque requirement-lineage record identity: "lineage:" followed by a lowercase slug.

TenantId.title: TenantId
TenantId.description: Opaque tenant identity: "tenant:" followed by a lowercase slug.

SolutionId.title: SolutionId
SolutionId.description: Opaque solution-package identity: "solution:" followed by a lowercase slug (stable across versions).

RequirementRef.title: RequirementRef
RequirementRef.description: One opaque requirement reference into a W036 ProgramOfWork: a work-package id or a solution-line id (never an embedded object).

WorkPackageId.title: WorkPackageId
WorkPackageId.description: Opaque work-package identity: "work-package:" followed by a lowercase slug.

SolutionLineId.title: SolutionLineId
SolutionLineId.description: Opaque solution-line identity: "line:" followed by a lowercase slug.

PackageId.title: PackageId
PackageId.description: Opaque acquisition-package identity: "package:" followed by a lowercase slug.

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (exactly three fractional digits, Z suffix).

PrincipalId.title: PrincipalId
PrincipalId.description: Opaque acting principal: "principal:" followed by a lowercase slug (W009 identity grammar).
